newPlatforms.name: Discover YOU RADIO Free Rotation Evaluation Form
newPlatforms.country: United States online independent-music radio and promotion platform; international artist eligibility is not explicitly stated.
newPlatforms.submissionMethod: official first-party public rotation-evaluation form using an iTunes track link

authorizedRoute.explicitPurpose: Submit one radio-friendly independent track for free initial rotation evaluation and possible addition to the station request catalog.
authorizedRoute.permittedAutomatedScope: discovery, passive verification, enrichment, deduplication and queueing only
authorizedRoute.safeHumanAction: Open the current official form, confirm eligibility and rights, review every visible and hidden requirement, and submit only after explicit owner approval.
authorizedRoute.internationalAcceptanceEvidence: The platform promotes independent artists generally but the current rotation-evaluation page does not explicitly state global eligibility.
authorizedRoute.standardRouteFeeEvidence: The current submission page states that all initial rotation evaluations are 100% free. Certificates of airplay and organic station-pitching are separate optional paid services.

businessContact.emailStatus: Three first-party domain-aligned business addresses were observed, but none is authorized as a substitute for the official rotation-evaluation form.
businessContact.verification: Email verification was limited to first-party publication, syntax, domain alignment and stated purpose. No SMTP, MX, catch-all, mailbox-level or deliverability probing was performed.

formBoundary.captchaStatus: No CAPTCHA was visible in the passively rendered page content. The dedicated agent-browser runner was unavailable, so hidden or submit-time anti-spam controls remain unverified.
formBoundary.loginStatus: The form fields are publicly rendered without a stated login requirement. A generic site 'Log out' link is present in the page footer but is not evidence that artists must authenticate.
formBoundary.paymentStatus: The standard initial evaluation is explicitly free. Optional certificates, station-pitching services and donations are adjacent payment boundaries and are excluded.
formBoundary.manualRecheckReason: Human review is required for clean-track selection, rights and AI eligibility, international eligibility, accurate form content, optional mailing-list consent, live anti-spam controls and separation from paid and sync-licensing services.
adjacentRoutesExcluded: general contact form and support mailboxes
separate sync-licensing form and uploads mailbox

activityVerification.evidence: The first-party Real Radio page presents an active request catalog and weekly scouting report, and the first-party Shows calendar lists live sessions on July 13-17 and July 20, 2026. The privacy policy is effective April 13, 2026.

genreFitEvidence: The platform is explicitly dedicated to independent artists and free initial radio rotation evaluation.
The current form is genre-neutral and prioritizes clean, radio-friendly material.
Selected MarcsMusic electronic, reggae, world-fusion, pop and instrumental tracks may fit after a human confirms the station's current programming and track-level suitability.
newPlatforms.manualReviewReason: The route is active and first-party, but a human must select a clean track, validate the iTunes link, confirm rights, AI and international eligibility, inspect live form controls, make an explicit mailing-list choice and keep optional paid, donation and sync-licensing routes outside the free evaluation workflow.

dedupeTerms: Discover YOU RADIO Free Rotation Evaluation Form
deduplication.repositoryEvidence: The complete accessible open pull-request patch was searched for the platform name and canonical domain and returned no match before creation.
deduplication.consolidation: The free rotation-evaluation form is stored once as the canonical opportunity. General support contacts, social direct messages, paid certificates, paid station-pitching, donations and the separate sync-licensing route are excluded.

notes: One Discover YOU RADIO opportunity was queued as needs_manual_review. No form field was filled, no link was submitted, no mailing-list consent was given, no login was used, no CAPTCHA was solved and no payment or submission action was completed.
